method: HE-Assisted Multi-Krum with Functional ILA-CKKS Aggregation
functional_he_update_scope: ILA-selected trainable tensors with selected-client buffer synchronization
privacy_architecture_note: Server role does not receive plaintext selected client updates; trusted authority decrypts distance scores and final selected-tensor aggregate. Single-process prototype still simulates all roles in one runtime.

history.distance_visibility: Server receives distance scores and selected indices, not plaintext selected client tensors.
history.selection_strategy: client-side ILA metadata; score = update_norm * fisher_score * gradient_variance
history.functional_he_update_scope: ILA-selected trainable tensors; non-selected floating buffers are synchronized from the same Multi-Krum-selected clients
